name: Rizuhble's Clingy Ex Bebop
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-6,400 (levels 1-12). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Exploding Uppercut T1, Grapple Arm T1, Hyper Beam T2. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Compress Cooldown completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 5 purchases

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Compress Cooldown completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Veil Walker, 9600 souls (~9.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 15 to Sticky Bomb's damage (1.50x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 27 to Sticky Bomb's damage (1.50x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Sticky Bomb: takes 18% off its 10s base cooldown.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Veil Walker, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 6,400-24,800 (levels 12-28). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Sticky Bomb T3, Hyper Beam T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Sticky Bomb, damage) grows from 272 to 350. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Veil Walker.

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Veil Walker
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Sticky Bomb (319) clears its 165-damage trigger; Exploding Uppercut stays under it. Takes spirit from 7,200 to 9,600 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Imbued on Sticky Bomb: widens its radius and range.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 10,400 to 12,000 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 144s; 20% off is 28.8s per full rotation.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Sticky Bomb: resets its 10s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Takes spirit from 12,000 to 18,400 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,800-51,200 (levels 28-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Exploding Uppercut T3, Grapple Arm T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Sticky Bomb, damage) grows from 350 to 495.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 75.3 per second to Hyper Beam's damage per second (2.51x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 18,400 to 23,200 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Hyper Beam beam length (70m), Hyper Beam beam close radius (5m), Hyper Beam beam end radius (4m). Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 25,600 to 32,000 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Veil Walker.
sections.desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Veil Walker.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Knockdown before it lands, Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Two or more gun heroes keep hitting you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: If you keep getting stunned or silenced before you can hook.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: Hyper Beam stacks it to max in one ult. Sell Veil Walker for this, or Spirit Snatch if it's gone.

items.name: Magic Carpet
items.caption: +14 spirit adds about 35.2 per second to Hyper Beam's damage per second (2.51x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Replaces Trophy Collector: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
